notes: Site is a client-rendered Next.js SPA (homepage/category HTML has no SSR nav content); category taxonomy and exact qty were read from the base64-encoded Redux state embedded in each category page's __NEXT_DATA__ (algoliaProductReducer.data.nbHits for qty, algoliaCategoryReducer.data.breadcrumbs for hierarchy/name), fetched via direct HTTP (curl with a browser UA; plain node https was blocked by Cloudflare, curl was not). robots.txt explicitly names anthropic-ai/Claude-Web/ClaudeBot with Allow: /. Checked: current live mega-menu (Furniture, Household, Kids, Baby, New Arrivals departments, full depth) - no seasonal/holiday nav item is currently surfaced (site is off-season in September). Checked category sitemap (sitemap_categories.xml) for both /ae/en/ and /ae/ar/ (identical slug structure) and grepped for eid, ramadan, diwali, deepavali, nowruz, new-year, valentine, halloween, easter, thanksgiving, national day, santa/xmas, occasion - only a 'household-christmas' branch exists; no other holiday category exists anywhere in the catalog. The only holiday category present is Christmas, sold under the site's own top label 'Festive' (url segment 'household-christmas'); confirmed as Christmas-specific (not a multi-holiday festive hub) because its only children are Decor & Tableware, Trees & Ornaments, and Wreaths/Garlands/Flowers - all Christmas-only product types (no Eid/Diwali/Ramadan content under it). Verified qty via parent/child nbHits cross-check: Decor & Tableware 24 = Cushions 2 + Decor Accessories 17 + Fragrance 0 + Lighting 4 + Tableware 1; Trees & Ornaments 23 = Trees 9 + Tree Ornaments 14; Wreaths/Garlands/Flowers 9 = Flowers 2 + Garlands 1 + Wreaths 6; top Festive/Christmas node 56 = 24+23+9. All sums matched exactly, confirming genuine parent/child structure (parents recorded as grouping rows only, qty null, per the no-double-count rule). One leaf, Fragrance (household-christmas-decorandtableware-fragrance), returned nbHits 0 and was dropped rather than written as a zero row (its catalogInfo confirms it is a real taxonomy node under Decor & Tableware, just currently empty of products). A separate 'household-giftingaccessories' branch (Accessories, Gifting) exists in the catalog but its breadcrumb is 'Household > Gifting & Accessories' with no holiday parent - generic year-round gifting, not associated with any specific festival by the site's own taxonomy, so excluded per the seasonal boundary rules.
